NewsFeedTexts.m_Text: Vanilla+ 1PP PVP on Chernarus. Survive first. One trading post. Raid weekends: Friday 18:00 through Monday 06:00 (server time).
Raiding is ONLY Fri 18:00-Mon 06:00. Use Expansion propane torch / bolt cutters in-window. Mid-week, raid tools will not work. Build like the weekend is coming.
Single Insight Trading Post (custom build + safezone). Sells food, meds, tools, ammo toppers, fishing gear, and vehicle repair parts. No gun mall. No aircraft.
Coastal spawns: Svetloyarsk, Berezino, Elektro, Chernogorsk. Insight Cell jobs are at Green Mountain — that area is NOT a safezone.
Scarce contested caches can appear near NWAF / VMC when enough players are online. Contested loot — bring a crew.
Talk to Mira at Green Mountain for Dead Drop. After Contested Trail, find The Post Still Stands. Board dailies unlock after Eyes Only.
